scope: Cold-start source audit of isolated no-host ra2 experiment

findings.fact: InitTxSTypeTable precedes hif_sys_init and RtmpNetTaskInit in rt28xx_init.
findings.limit: Initialization ordering alone does not prove absence of old hardware reports.

findings.fact: Initialization zeroes TxSStatus slots and enables host beacon TxS for all WLAN indices.
findings.limit: Never use table zeroing as proof of hardware/RF retirement.

findings.fact: MT beacon helper zeroes MAC_TX_INFO and TXD, leaves PID zero, assigns both bss_idx and TxSPriv from apidx and calls write_tmac_info.
APMakeBssBeacon returns for HIF_MT before its later constructor call. Live MT beacon construction is in APUpdateBeaconFrame.
Zero PID selects TYPE1. Experimental static exact-three-BSS ra2 predicate suppresses allocation in that branch from its first qualifying invocation.
findings.limit: Predicate continuity depends on BssidNum and actual build composition.

findings.fact: Virtual netdev allocation failure rewrites BssidNum to failed index.
findings.consequence: Cold-mode acceptance must include successful exact-three-BSS registration. Do not treat configured BssidNum as immutable.

next_required: Verify composed profile/init and all constructor call sites retain exact ra2 identity before publication.
Define admission on registration failure and lifecycle changes before enabling experiment.
Verify no production tracked-to-untracked live mode transition is exposed.
Complete isolated module link, then scoped owner release/reopen integration.

host_checks.limits: Injected adapter/netdev state, no target or device execution. General third-BSS admission permits count4; Linux OPEN owner binding separately requires exact count3.

cleanup: Temporary fixture executables removed by TemporaryDirectory.

composed_producer_check.finding: Actual composed MT virtual wrapper calls its inner builder only after producer acquisition and periodic readiness. Experimental readiness requires exact BssidNum3 before constructor entry. A count mismatch is refused before beacon PID allocation through this wrapper.
composed_producer_check.limits: Source-composition assertion; no hardware epoch, all-path concurrency, or reopen acceptance.
